title: Add include_bead_state kwarg to update_gitignore() in scaffold.py
description: In src/agent_takt/onboarding/scaffold.py: (1) add include_bead_state: bool = False kwarg to update_gitignore() (scaffold.py:96); when True, append .takt/beads/ to the to-add list before the existing dedup logic runs — do not modify _GITIGNORE_ENTRIES; (2) in scaffold_project() (scaffold.py:307), pass include_bead_state=True when calling update_gitignore() for a fresh takt init. Leave onboarding/upgrade.py untouched.
acceptance_criteria: update_gitignore(include_bead_state=True) adds .takt/beads/ to .gitignore when not already present
Calling update_gitignore(include_bead_state=True) when .takt/beads/ is already in .gitignore is idempotent — no duplicate, returns False
